# XMEL Automations

> AI automation agency building autonomous voice AI agents, n8n workflow automations, and intelligent lead response systems for businesses across real estate and home services.

XMEL Automations designs, builds, and deploys AI-powered systems that eliminate manual bottlenecks in lead response, customer communication, and operational workflows. We use GPT-4o-mini, Twilio, Vapi, ElevenLabs, and n8n to create autonomous systems that respond instantly, 24/7.

Founded by Yashwardhan Chauhan, based in India, serving real estate and home-service businesses in the United States and India.

## Pricing

Every build starts with a 14-day pilot on the client's real leads; if it does not outperform their current process, they owe nothing.

- United States (https://xmelautomations.xyz/#pricing): Starter (AI lead responder) from $997 setup + $197/month; Growth (AI inside sales agent with voice calls and booking) from $2,497 setup + $497/month; Custom for teams and multi-location businesses. Call and text usage billed at cost.
- India (https://xmelautomations.xyz/in#pricing): Starter from ₹24,999 setup + ₹4,999/month; Growth from ₹59,999 setup + ₹9,999/month; Custom on request. WhatsApp and call usage billed at cost; GST extra where applicable.

## Homepages

- [United States](https://xmelautomations.xyz/): AI that texts and calls new leads from Zillow, Realtor.com, Facebook ads and websites in under 60 seconds.
- [India](https://xmelautomations.xyz/in): AI that replies on WhatsApp to MagicBricks, 99acres and Housing.com leads in under 60 seconds and books site visits.

## Services

- [AI Automation for Real Estate Agents](https://xmelautomations.xyz/ai-automation-real-estate): AI inside sales agents that respond to real estate leads in under 50 seconds — qualifying, booking, and syncing to CRM.
- [AI Automation for Home Services](https://xmelautomations.xyz/ai-automation-home-services): AI receptionists and lead response systems for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors that stop missed calls from costing jobs.
- [AI Lead Response Automation](https://xmelautomations.xyz/#how-it-works): Autonomous systems that qualify, respond to, and book appointments with inbound leads across voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and web forms.
- [Voice AI Agent Development](https://xmelautomations.xyz/#how-it-works): Custom AI phone agents built on Vapi, Twilio, and ElevenLabs that answer calls, qualify prospects, and book appointments 24/7.
- [n8n Workflow Automation](https://xmelautomations.xyz/#how-it-works): Complex multi-step automations connecting CRM, lead qualification, appointment booking, notifications, and data sync.
- [WhatsApp Automation Bot](https://xmelautomations.xyz/#how-it-works): AI-powered WhatsApp chatbots that qualify leads, answer questions, and sync data to CRM in real time.
